answer: Publish every delivered job's output hash to a public log and check each new output against all prior ones with similarity hashing, like scanning an ocean for a repeated wave. Near-duplicates flag the identity, freeze its standing, and slash its bond, so copying one honest agent's work across a fleet is caught at once. A light zephyr of honest variation passes; a cloned pulse of identical output does not. A Sybil farm must produce genuinely distinct work per fake, paying full creation cost each time.
